title: Agent MCP follow-ups: resource subscriptions and packaged-Tauri hosting
description: Post-MVP follow-ups from docs/19-agent-interface.md §MVP scope (Out). Do not start until 0613/0614/0615 are done. (1) MCP resource subscriptions / change notifications: notify subscribed clients on doc-changed (with rev), selection-changed, and playhead moves via standard MCP resource update notifications; add flash-agent sugar to stream them as JSON lines. (2) Packaged-Tauri hosting: serve the same MCP server without the Vite dev server (Rust MCP implementation in apps/desktop/src-tauri or a Node sidecar) reusing @flash/agent-protocol and the editor-side registry unchanged. (3) Optional: multi-editor session routing (named sessions) and MCP prompts for canned authoring recipes. Split into separate tasks if scope grows.
